verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents start cloud browser sessions, interact with pages, fetch data and build scripts. Its integration guides for CrewAI and the Vercel AI SDK tell users to point an MCP client at the Notte MCP server, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and detailed setup or tool-list specifics in the evidence.
